sections.label: 📝 Docs
items: Two long-lived project documents were renamed, and every live cross-reference to them inside the userscript's own comments and JSDoc was retargeted: `debug/NOTES.md` → `DEBUG-NOTES.md` (24 references) and `pageTypes-testing-reference.org` → `PAGETYPES-TESTING-REFERENCE.org` (1 reference). Comment-only; no runtime behaviour changes.

`DEBUG-NOTES.md` moved out of `debug/` deliberately. That directory is excluded by a bare `debug/` in the root `.gitignore`, and the file was tracked only because it had been force-added to the index — there is no `!` negation for it, and one could not work, since git never descends into an excluded directory. At the top level it no longer depends on that fragile arrangement.
Fixed a stale symbol name in a comment: `_msIdbPutLength` → `_msIdbPutLengths` (the function has been plural since it was written; the singular form appears nowhere in the code).
The changelog's own historical entries were deliberately left pointing at the old filenames — they describe what shipped at those versions, and rewriting them would falsify the record.
